text: Profile-specific services such as ML tracking, data versioning, browser QA, cloud emulation, or image-generation workers shall remain disabled unless required by the project profile.

PostgreSQL plus pgvector is the default semantic retrieval boundary. Exact source-address retrieval and deterministic metadata filters remain the fallback and verification path. Standalone vector services stay profile-gated until retrieval benchmarks justify extraction.
Preserve exact identifiers, lexical retrieval, line-addressed sources, and deterministic filters when semantic ranking is unavailable.
